professional_design_crit.claim: The sparse front Source edit measurably establishes a positive hood-center versus fender-crown hierarchy without damaging the V49 fold-free evaluated surface.
professional_design_crit.first_read: The held-out 3/4 previews still read as a generic/toy sports-car proxy rather than a convincing 992.2 identity.
professional_design_crit.geometry_construction: Primary body is continuous and fold-free at the current machine gate, but visible aperture and lamp interface architecture is not mature enough to support professional reference-reproduction fidelity.
professional_design_crit.scale_proportion: Gross hard points remain controlled; the cabin/window/pillar read and front opening hierarchy remain visually under-resolved relative to the primary mass.
professional_design_crit.material_light: The studio render is adequate for defect visibility but is not evidence of physical CMF or Class-A reflection fairness.
professional_design_crit.cross_view_consistency: The same unresolved greenhouse/aperture architecture is visible in HERO_FRONT_3Q, TOP_FRONT_3Q and orthographic views; the issue is structural rather than a single-camera artifact.
professional_design_crit.portfolio_value: Not MAIN/KEEP at V59. The benchmark is valuable as technical training evidence, not as a finished automotive modeling result.
professional_design_crit.root_cause_detail: Windshield, side glazing, rear glass, A/C pillars and roof-rail junctions remain proxy/infill overlays rather than one shared-boundary host-opening-interface-infill-backing architecture. This dominates the held-out 3/4 identity read and prevents the successful hood-fender relation from producing a convincing 992.2 result.
